response.sql:
WITH observatory_counts AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
shares AS (
  SELECT telescope_count,
         telescope_count::numeric / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM observatory_counts
),
averages AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT AVG(s.telescope_count) AS average_telescope_count,
       AVG(s.share) AS average_share,
       AVG(s.share - a.average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM shares AS s
CROSS JOIN averages AS a
WHERE s.share > a.average_share;

assumptions.assumption: The observatories to include are those represented by at least one row in telescopes; observatories with no telescopes are not counted in the shares or average share because the requested counts are grouped from the telescopes table.

alternatives.interpretation: Include every observatory, including those with zero telescopes, when calculating the average share and selecting above-average observatories.
alternatives.sql:
WITH observatory_counts AS (
  SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count
  FROM observatories AS o
  LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.observstation
),
shares AS (
  SELECT telescope_count,
         telescope_count::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(telescope_count) OVER (), 0) AS share
  FROM observatory_counts
),
averages AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT AVG(s.telescope_count) AS average_telescope_count,
       AVG(s.share) AS average_share,
       AVG(s.share - a.average_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM shares AS s
CROSS JOIN averages AS a
WHERE s.share > a.average_share;
